profile.headline: I make map software
profile.summary: Passionate about collaborating with an agile team to solve complex spatial problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
■ Develop and maintain the Flyover data processing pipeline in Python, JavaScript, and C.
■ Scale to thousands of instances using Docker, Splunk, Kafka, Redis, and blob storage.
■ Support 24/7 data collection backend services for various sensor platforms.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
■ Developed and maintained single page application for exploratory spatial data analysis using AngularJS, Bootstrap, and Leaflet, paired with Java REST services and MongoDB.
■ Supported 10k users through automated testing and deployment with Jasmine and Jenkins.
■ Championed performance metrics and improvement, achieving a 90% reduction in time to load search results, eliminating over 1 MB of data transfer and over 30 unbundled and unnecessary network requests.

positions.title: Scientist / Engineer
positions.description:
■ Developed a web-based solar power siting application from early concept through several release cycles using JavaScript, OpenLayers, and ExtJS, performing tool development, release management, and quality assurance roles.
■ Created a cloud-based system for real-time monitoring of mobile radiation sensors, including a detector client touch application in C++/CLI, C#, and WPF, paired with an Amazon EC2 back end hosting Java Servlets in Tomcat with MongoDB storage.
■ Developed a desktop application to simulate cascading failures in infrastructure using ArcGIS Engine and WPF in C#, serving as Scrum Master and ‘go-to’ developer for 5-person team.
■ Engineered an efficient web portal in Dojo, ASP.NET WebAPI, ArcGIS Server, and PLSQL/Oracle.
■ Implemented a novel graph conflation tool for power grid data based on the Gale–Shapley algorithm in C#.
■ Ported a network traffic visualization into an immersive 3D environment using OpenGL in C and C++.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
■ Led development of an agent-based pedestrian simulation using C++, Boost, and OpenGL, including a posterori collision detection engine for sphere-sphere and sphere-poly physics.
■ Devised a unique agent navigation routine that used simulated annealing to avoid collisions.
■ Automated post-simulation scene rendering with 3ds Max SDK and Maxscript.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
■ Developed and maintained emergency vehicle dispatch software in C, C++ and Java using Scrum.
■ Performed initial development for a new software version in C# compatible with legacy code.
■ Earned confidence of C-level executives for twelve-hour turnaround on critical reported defects.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: ■ Assistant taught a section of CS 1021 Introduction to Java.

projects.title: PVMapper
projects.description:
A $2.8 mil DOE SunShot Initiative Project to Develop an Open-Source Utility-Scale Solar PV Project Siting Tool
Principal Investigator: D. Solan, Ph.D.
Co-PIs: Randy Lee (INL) / Daniel Ames (BYU)
Partner(s): Idaho National Laboratory; Brigham Young University, University of Idaho, Idaho State University

publications.title: Enhancing user customization through novel software architecture for utility-scale solar siting software
publications.publisher: International Environmental Modeling and Software Society, 7th International Congress on Environmental Modeling and Software, San Diego, CA, USA
